stem.text: A ball of mass $0.5\,\text{kg}$ hits a vertical wall at a speed of $12\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. It bounces back along its original path with a speed of $8\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The collision lasts for $0.10\,\text{s}$.
